title: Claude Code Just Added Routines (Here's How They Work)
description:
Anthropic added routines to Claude Code. Write a prompt once, set a schedule or trigger, and Claude runs it automatically. Works with Gmail, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive. Pro gets 5 per day, Max gets 15. It just dropped as a research preview, so it's only getting better from here.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Tbj9MsHIG4PTd3jEjlXn6YvBnL7wfxcEffMvuP7oAl0/edit
